messages:
yasmin.rolf: hey team, brand new here (day 1). trying to map who to ping for a few quick onboarding ownership questions: (1) who owns alert ownership for the 'serving' service, (2) who approves access removals when someone leaves, (3) canonical codeowner for infra/provisioning, and (4) who to cc on cross-region incident escalations? thanks!
jake-sre: welcome @yasmin.rolf! alert ownership for serving is oncall SRE by default, service steward is @felix-infra for infra runbook updates. during an incident SRE coordinates alerts + mitigations.
marta-devex: hi @yasmin.rolf 01 - codeowners live in the repo CODEOWNERS file (github.com/redwood/redwood-serving/.github/CODEOWNERS). infra provisioning codeowner is @felix-infra and platform lead. if you want me to walk through it, i can do a 20m walkthrough.
felix-infra: for access removals we follow the offboarding flow: people-ops triggers `OFFBOARD` ticket which kicks off access-bot to remove SSO groups, service accounts, and infra roles. if you're cleaning up access for a test service, open an INFRA ticket and tag me.
access-bot: Reminder: Offboarding flow requires manager sign-off + HR trigger. See https://redwood.internal/offboard for checklist.
linda-peopleops: offboarding checklist: manager confirmation, exit interview scheduled, asset return, and JIRA: OFFBOARD created. People Ops will not remove badges until HR confirms return. ping me if you need to expedite.
jake-sre: escalation path summary: owner -> oncall SRE -> platform lead (@felix-infra) -> eng director -> CTO for cross-region sev1. On-call rotations and contact details are on the rota page.
marta-devex: small tip: if you're unsure who is "owner" for a subcomponent, check the service metadata tag: `owner:` in the internal catalog (search by service name). happy to show you where it is.
yasmin.rolf: this is super helpful, thanks everyone. @felix-infra i'll open a quick ticket to remove a test token and cc you. @marta-devex yes please for the 20m walk-through, when are you free? :smile:
